name: a< then remount: no page error from the pending Insert-mode key
why: Ends in Insert mode with `<` waiting 200 ms for a <C-…> key; the next case's mount destroys the editor first, which used to make that timer throw (a page error at the end). Mode not compared: the browser is read inside that 200 ms window, with `<` still in codemirror-vim's key buffer (pending); Neovim is in Insert mode.
